## Plain-English Assessment

The system is experiencing **memory pressure with a handle leak in explorer.exe**. Free physical memory stands at 15.4 GB (94% of total), which is healthy, but the Windows Explorer process has accumulated 11,641 handles—substantially above the ~10,000 threshold that suggests a leak. However, the high handle count in a user-facing process warrants immediate investigation, as handle exhaustion can degrade system responsiveness and prevent new resource allocation.
